verdict.rationale: Cline is a general agent that reads and writes files and runs terminal commands (cline-docs-31, cline-docs-14). Its docs explicitly show "run tests and fix failures" (cline-docs-33) and advertise linter-aware fixes (cline-docs-30), so the test and lint parts of the story are evidenced. Merge-conflict resolution and dependency updates are only implied by its general command and edit abilities. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of writing new tests (not just fixing failures), merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, and independent hands-on corroboration of these specific tasks.
